title: silver-lake-retail-integration-call-notes-2026-06-02
content:
Meeting: Silver Lake Retail (initial technical scoping)
Date: 2026-06-02
Attendees: Jordan Kim (Redwood SE), Priya Shah (Redwood Solutions), Luca Moreno (Silver Lake - Eng Lead), Anya Rodriguez (Silver Lake - Product), Casey Tran (Silver Lake - Secops backup)

High-level ask:
- Silver Lake wants Redwood to power in-store assistant and post-purchase support for receipts/returns. Primary goals: fast checkout suggestions (<=150ms tail latency for short prompts), embedding-based search over receipts, and PII-safe handling of payment/card metadata.
- Target initial rollout in 50 stores, ~50 reqs/sec steady, peak ~200 reqs/sec during promos.

Notes / Requirements captured:
- Deployment preference: Private (VPC) in their AWS account. They require customer-managed KMS and private network (no egress).
- Data residency: US-only. Logs with PII must be disabled or redacted; they want event-only metrics forwarded to Redwood console (tokenized).
- Model constraints: prefer smaller local LLMs (e.g., Llama 2 13B baseline) tuned for domain, with a hosted fallback (Redwood-hosted lower-cost model) for overflow. Need to validate quality on returns phrasing.
- Latency SLO: 95th <=150ms for <64-token responses for the checkout suggestion route. Embeddings route can be higher (<=300ms 95th). Need to confirm sequence length distribution; they estimate most prompts <40 tokens.
- Throughput: expect 50 TPS initially; auto-scaling policy required for store bursts. They want deterministic cost forecasting (reserved pool + burst).
- Security & compliance: SOC2 required; they will provide an ATO checklist. HSM integration desired but not mandatory day 1.

Gotchas / Risks noted:
- Legacy POS systems in some stores only allow TLS1.1 proxies — ops friction. Must confirm network path and propose a TLS termination or edge proxy plan.
- Tokenization: receipts include varied structured lines and OCR noise. Embedding quality may degrade without a pre-processing step to normalize line breaks and currency formatting.
- Offline mode: several stores have intermittent connectivity; need graceful degradation (local cache of rules or deferred processing). This complicates real-time suggestions.
- PCI scope: they are wary of any card PAN touching Redwood systems. Must ensure tokenization or client-side redaction before sending.

Open technical questions to resolve:
- Do they want Redwood to run entirely inside their VPC (control plane + data plane) or is a split-plane option ok (control plane in Redwood with data plane in-customer)? They said prefer full-private but will consider split if network ops easier.
- Need sample traffic (prompts, receipts, embedding vectors) and a representative latency histogram from their current NLP pipelines. Ask: can they provide 1k sample prompts + 100 receipts?
- What is their expected retention window for logs/requests? They suggested 7 days for debug, 0 days for raw PII.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Jordan: Build initial private deployment proposal (network diagram + KMS notes) and send to Luca & Casey. ETA: 2026-06-05.
- Priya: Draft SOW outline (reserved capacity + burst pricing) and sample SLA; include support tiers. ETA: 2026-06-07.
- Luca: Provide sample prompts + OCR receipts (anonymized) and current traffic histograms. ETA: 2026-06-04.
- Anya: Clarify business metrics for success (reduction in checkout time, return resolution time targets). ETA: 2026-06-08.
- Security: Coordinate with Casey on KMS/HSM requirements and send Redwood's security questionnaire. ETA: 2026-06-06.

Next steps / follow-up:
- Schedule deep-dive with infra & SRE (Redwood) to validate VPC peering options and egress restrictions. Proposed slot: 2026-06-09.
- Proof-of-concept plan: 2-week pilot in 5 stores using Redwood Private (small pool) + local preprocessing. Need to confirm data flow and redaction steps before pilot.
- Create JIRA epic SLR-1023 and add tasks for network, deployment, ingestion preprocessor, and eval suite for returns prompts.

Meeting notes (informal):
- Luca skeptical about running full control plane in-customer due to additional ops. Mentioned they'd accept split control/data plane if control plane can be restricted to metadata only.
- Anya emphasized needing a simple fallback UX if latency spikes — prefer showing cached suggestions vs blocking checkout.
- Casey flagged immediate requirement: no raw PANs into Redwood. We must provide clear client-side redaction SDK or a server-side tokenization guide.

Quick win ideas:
- Provide a lightweight JS SDK snippet for client-side redaction + request signing to reduce PCI scope.
- Offer an embedding preprocessor script that normalizes currency, date, and line-breaks to improve vector similarity.

References / links to attach later:
- Confluence onboarding checklist: CONFLUENCE-Page: silver-lake-retail-onboarding
- JIRA epic: JIRA-SLR-1023
- Slack channel: #solutions-silver-lake

Status: draft notes for internal alignment. Ready to convert to a customer-facing summary once we get sample data and confirm deployment mode.
